issues: Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Delivery performance was poor across the region, with high rider waiting times, missing items and insufficient photographic evidence attached to claims.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The new loyalty system is letting customers stack multiple vouchers on a single tab, and several sites reported display and redemption problems.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Takeaway packaging from China has still not arrived and sites are waiting on it for delivery presentation.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Event food spend continues to sit within site food cost, but the food cost budget will be increased for sites running B2B events.
Sales were down week on week, with a sharp Sunday drop after a strong Saturday, attributed to guests coming in mainly for discount vouchers.
Delivery prep times were high on Saturday, Sunday and Thursday because of unexpected spikes in volume.
Some delivery tickets failed to print on both delivery platforms, linked to auto stock settings not being updated on the delivery tablets.
The loyalty app activates several rewards at once for guests at sign up, so staff cannot enforce a single redemption at the till.
Labour cost ran high, driven mainly by the shortfall in sales rather than by hours.
Food cost came in low because of stock carried over from the previous week, creating a risk of insufficient cover for the week ahead.
A minor maintenance issue was reported, which the site will fix in house.
HR concern raised - a staff complaint by Abi against Sam regarding work performance, with Inka already aware.
